column2: 使用 skills/goai-idea-forge/SKILL.md 复测刚修复的无机route-to-plan适配。真实调用 provider_status，确认molecular_provider_trusted与local_inorganic_ready分离；重新调用predict_precursor_routes(Li7La3Zr2O12,top_k=5)，确认每条route携带provider/model_output_verified/chemical_route_verified；对Top1调用make_experiment_plan。覆盖 workspace/ideas/retro_llzo_top5.json 和 experiment_llzo_diagnostic.json，并在proposal的风险段追加“适配修复后复测”结果。验收：plan.steps恰有1个、inputs为Top1三种前驱体、provider=local_two_stage_inorganic、provider_verified=true、chemical_route_verified=false、conditions仍为TODO/null且NOT FOR LAB USE。不得设ideas_reviewed PASS；loopctl log event=diagnostic_repair。
